description: This header defines macros for transforming variadic macro arguments into repeated macro invocations, including concatenation and argument counting, used internally in the Abseil C++ library.

methods.name: ABSL_INTERNAL_CAT
methods.description: Concatenates two tokens after macro expansion.

methods.name: ABSL_INTERNAL_TRANSFORM_ARGS
methods.description: Transforms a macro and variadic arguments into multiple macro invocations separated by commas.

methods.name: ABSL_INTERNAL_NUM_ARGS
methods.description: Counts the number of variadic arguments passed to the macro.
